edits.value_json: {"text":"The cart stood in the parade lane as a towering float, its enormous banner lifting above the stones like a bright red sail. Mallow beamed at it, while Tuck gave the wooden handle an affectionate pat.","when":[{"key":"cart.mode","op":"eq","value":"float","at":"after"}]}

{"text":"At the neighborhood stop, the loaded cart waited like a friendly little library on wheels. The bell hung ready beside the books, and a child peeped around the corner, already reaching for a story.","when":[{"key":"cart.mode","op":"eq","value":"bookmobile","at":"after"},{"key":"cart.location","op":"eq","value":"neighborhood_stop","at":"after"}]}

{"text":"In the parade lane, the cart opened its shelves into a tiny traveling reading room. Books nestled inside, waiting for the first listener to choose a place beside the wheels.","when":[{"key":"cart.mode","op":"eq","value":"reading_room","at":"after"}]}
